toolchain.numeric_core: decimal.Decimal precision 50 with ROUND_HALF_EVEN; fractions.Fraction where exact
toolchain.external_solver_policy: an external solver is corroborative only until its exact version, model files, options and convergence checks are hash-bound in a reviewed contract

tolerance_policy.normal_and_degraded_states: evaluate all legal discrete states and every applicable min/max corner
tolerance_policy.typical_values: informative only and never sufficient for pass
tolerance_policy.correlation: apply correlation only when an authoritative source states it; otherwise enumerate independent bounds
tolerance_policy.passive_derating: apply value tolerance, voltage/current/power derating, temperature coefficient and frequency or DC-bias dependence whenever applicable
tolerance_policy.units: store value and margin in explicit SI or named engineering units

methods.method: deterministic interval/corner enumeration over authoritative min/max tolerances and legal discrete modes
methods.anti_shortcut: typical values, undocumented defaults and Monte Carlo percentiles cannot prove pass

methods.method: closed-form KCL/KVL, source ORing, conversion efficiency and dissipation envelopes for every legal source/load state
methods.anti_shortcut: a hidden aggregate load or unexplained efficiency allowance is forbidden

methods.method: bounded piecewise-linear or datasheet behavioral transient model with explicit initial conditions and dt versus dt/2 convergence
methods.anti_shortcut: a plotted waveform without thresholds, input provenance and convergence margin is non-evidence

methods.method: deterministic state, arbitration, watchdog, reset, recovery and single-fault enumeration
methods.anti_shortcut: a nominal happy path cannot close safety, quiet-state or ownership requirements

methods.method: bounded small-signal, gain, noise, bandwidth, loading and threshold equations with exact selected-part applicability
methods.anti_shortcut: a family reference circuit cannot replace exact selected-value and load corners

methods.method: VIH/VIL/VOH/VOL, leakage, pull, power-off, fanout, setup/hold and occupancy algebra for each endpoint and bus
methods.anti_shortcut: logic-family names or nominal clock rates cannot replace endpoint limits and worst-case service time

methods.method: source-to-port 50-ohm pre-layout loss/mismatch/isolation budget plus deterministic one-active-group and three-nRF service analysis
methods.anti_shortcut: pre-layout work cannot claim final impedance, radiated performance, antenna match or coexistence; those remain H6/H8

methods.method: worst-case dissipation with bounded junction/board/enclosure/cell thermal resistance and capacitance networks
methods.anti_shortcut: unknown enclosure or interface resistance is a range, never a guessed scalar

methods.method: machine join from every frozen sheet, component, net, requirement and method result to one downstream physical residual owner
methods.anti_shortcut: an unlinked pass, orphan input or unowned uncertainty cannot close H3

pass_fail_rules.rule: Every normal and allowed degraded corner remains inside manufacturer recommended operating conditions; absolute maximum is never a design target.
A missing min/max tolerance, applicability condition, unit or model provenance makes the owning result unresolved_fail.
Steady rail/source current retains at least 25% reserve over enumerated worst-case load; a named transient-only rating requires separate transient proof.
A regulated rail retains at least 5% nominal-voltage headroom after source tolerance, distribution loss and steady droop while every load stays in its supply range.
Worst-case timing and shared-resource occupancy consume no more than 80% of the assigned deadline or service budget; independent buses are never combined artificially.
Power-off, reset and quiet-state combinations cannot back-power or enable a transmitter; any allowed injection stays below the exact published limit with at least 2x analytical reserve.
Predicted junction temperature stays at least 20 C below its applicable maximum; cell charge/discharge temperature stays at least 10 C inside exact cell and charger limits.
Transient results at dt and dt/2 differ by no more than 10% of the remaining pass margin; otherwise the timestep is reduced or the result is unresolved_fail.
Every single fault reaches a bounded-energy safe state without relying on the same failed compute domain, and a readable cause remains recoverable whenever energy remains.
RF pre-layout pass means only a complete constraint and margin budget; final feed, antenna, VNA, spectrum and coexistence claims require H6/H8 evidence.
Every calculator emits all evaluated states/corners, the worst case, numeric margin, outcome and physical residual; summary-only output is non-evidence.
Input hash drift, tool-policy drift, a failed margin or an unowned residual invalidates acceptance and requires downstream regeneration.
